## Review pull requests with multiple engines
Run Claude, Codex, and Antigravity against a pull request diff at the same time. Kulula brings their findings together, highlights where they agree or disagree, and can use the results to guide Auto Fix rounds. You choose which engines take part in Settings; standalone reviews remain available.
## Work through reviews more clearly
Review findings and controls are easier to follow in the review panel, with improved filtering, layout, and progress feedback. You can now choose the engine and model for review fixes and local reviews, and see clearer status when a review is running or blocked.
## More reliable conversations
Approvals and engine responses are handled more consistently, including when a turn is cancelled or an engine session is replaced. The app also checks for updates at launch and hourly.

- Pin threads to keep important work close at hand, with a shorter recent-thread list for each project. - Copy transcript messages and follow live turn progress. Submitted messages appear immediately, and streamed responses keep a steadier layout. - Choose models for review fixes, retain review filters as you navigate, and see a review log scoped to the selected pull request. - Enjoy clearer review actions, severity badges, refresh indicators, and Auto Fix startup status. Pull is disabled for merged pull requests. - The right-hand panel remembers its width across relaunches. - Open plan usage from Status, check Git and GitHub CLI availability, and see whether a Decisions API key is configured in Settings.

# What’s new in Kulula 0.9.0
- Get a system notification when a thread needs your input or finishes in the background. - Refresh pull request findings manually, and find closed pull requests under the History filter. - See Claude session limits and clearer usage warnings in Status. - Keep composer drafts when switching threads, navigate suggestions with the keyboard, and use slash action suggestions after model mentions. - Select inline transcript notes and read longer approval commands without truncation. - Continue thread work after a worktree moves or is lost.
